subject: TwelveLabs Pegasus 1.6 structures first-person video for Physical AI data curation
summary: TwelveLabs released Pegasus 1.6 on October 6 with first-person video understanding, better entity recognition, native image support, and structured tags and timestamps for robotic onboard-camera footage. This provides upstream video understanding for data curation, not independently tested robotics training outcomes or executable robot skills.
